svg.text: Example 3. A one-word exchange: every tile sends one word to every tile, through the send port
REGISTERS.md 7.3 — mode 7 from the send port, over the mesh, into data memory by port B: every tile does both, outgoing and incoming at once
DMA_REPLY_REMAINING = 64; // first: 64 words will land here
at = CM_WORD(&in[me]); // the same word on every tile
for each d, in the schedule's order {
ROUTER_SEND_LO = out[d]; // one word to tile d
in[0..63]: one word from each tile
eject: every packet for this tile

local wake: every counter done → WFI returns
modes 2, 4: at PTR[src]; mode 3: at PTR[bucket digit]; then += 2
mode 4: high 32 bits ← ordinal from DMA_RECORD_BASE_ADDRESS
SRAM read queue: one request a cycle,
a register store: the program's line
a step of the data flow (below)
outgoing: this tile's words to the others
incoming: the others' words to this tile
A store to ROUTER_SEND_LO puts the packet {dst d, mode 7, addr at, payload out[d]} into
the send port's holding register; the store stalls only while the previous packet still
The injection point takes it into the router, one packet per cycle (read returns would go
The router sends it towards tile d over the mesh, horizontal first, then vertical. The
word to this tile itself (d = me) takes the loopback instead.
At the same time the other tiles' words arrive from the mesh.
The router ejects every packet with dst = me to the traffic director.
The director routes mode 7 to port B and decrements DMA_REPLY_REMAINING; port B writes
the word at the sender's addr: in[s] for sender s.
The 64th word in: DMA_REPLY_REMAINING = 0 and cm_idle, so the local wake fires and WFI
Inset: two tiles, me and d, joined by the mesh (every tile does both)
the mesh: one or more hops
A one-word exchange uses no engine: the program sends through the send port, and the traffic director hands every arriving word to port B, which writes it where
its sender said (REGISTERS.md 2.5). Every tile does both at once, so the counter must be set before any word can arrive: it is the command's first store, by identical
code on every tile. 64 words go out and 64 come in, the word to itself through the loopback.
Source: REGISTERS.md 2.2, 2.3.3, 2.5; RECIPES.md 7 (xchg(), send_words()); spec/machine-spec.md v1.0, §3.1, §3.2, §4.11, §4.12; the tile map is figure 1.3's.
